title: Washington releases 20 lab-raised sunflower stars to restore kelp forests
summary_full: In a remarkable conservation initiative, twenty lab-raised sunflower sea stars have been released back into the Salish Sea. This effort seeks to restore a species that has suffered extensively due to disease, crucial for the health of kelp forest ecosystems. The project, undertaken in collaboration with the Samish Indian Nation and various researchers, symbolizes hope for restoring ecological balance in the region.
